thread:
maria: Heads up — Deepfield just sent an RFI, deadline EOD Friday. They want capability matrix, security Q answers, and POC timeline. Any blockers?

alex: Got it. Can we reuse the Aurora matrix? Need to update Dedicated/Private columns and pricing buckets.

jen: I can draft the matrix. What's the expected POC size? They mentioned 100 qps sustained and embedding throughput.

maria: Yes — 100 qps gen, 500 embeddings/min. Priority: data residency + HSM. They asked about on-prem as well.

ravi: Security questionnaire — they need KMS/HSM, SOC2 attestation, and FedRAMP is a nice-to-have. We support customer-managed KMS for Private and HSM via partner for Dedicated. I'll start answers; need sample artifacts (SOC2 report, subprocessor list).

sam: For sustained 100 qps we'll recommend Dedicated with autoscale and burst to 150. Also enable prefix caching and continuous batching for embeddings. I'll add perf guidance.

ops-bot: Uploaded: /attachments/deepfield_rfi_materials/initial_network_diagram.png

alex: Pricing — propose two paths: 1) Reserved monthly (Dedicated) + usage overage, 2) PAYG hosted with burst credits. I'll draft both. Maria, confirm procurement timeline.

maria: Procurement window mid-June. Legal will ask for DPA + SLA tweaks.

jen: POC runbook draft: Week1 baseline tests (latency/accuracy), Week2 scale and security verification, sign-off meeting. Need infra contact for VPC peering and CID ranges.

maria: Deepfield SRE contact is @ops-team. I'll intro and request CID ranges.

ravi: Security notes for RFI answers: encryption at rest AES-256; envelope encryption with customer KMS (RSA-OAEP); HSM support via partner (FIPS 140-2 level 2); audit logs available 90 days (expandable); temp credentials rotated every 24h. I'll attach template answers.

alex: They also want embedding dims, output formats, and 99th percentile latency. Jen, can you paste perf bullets?

jen: Perf bullets (preliminary): embeddings ~12ms/op on p3/4; gen median 70ms @ 16 tokens on g5; 95p latency < 300ms for typical 64-token responses. Will validate in benchmark CSV.

maria: Ok assemble: matrix + SQA answers + SOW draft + pricing. Any blocking legal/ops items?

ravi: Legal will likely request subprocessor list and isv indemnity language. I can preempt by including our standard subprocessors and control mappings.

sam: Technical constraint: private deployment requires peering across two AZs; they want cross-AZ failover. We can support, but need their expected failover RTO/RPO.

maria: I'll ask for RTO/RPO and the CID ranges. Also note: they want canary rollback policy during POC — we'll include that.

alex: I'll prepare an executive one-pager and capability matrix. Jen please own matrix. Target: initial packet to customer by Wed EOD.

jen: On it. Dropping the first draft here tomorrow. :thumbsup:

jen: Matrix excerpt:
```
Feature,Hosted,Dedicated,Private
Latency SLA,100ms,50ms,50-200ms
KMS/HSM,AES-256,AES-256 w/ partner,HSM + customer-managed KMS
Autoscale,Yes,Yes,Depends on infra
Data residency,Region-level,Region-level,Customer VPC
```

maria: Thanks all — once draft is ready I'll upload and ping legal/security for final signoff.

ops-bot: Uploaded: /attachments/deepfield_rfi_materials/deepfield_capability_matrix_v1.csv

alex: FYI — include a note about rollback/fallthrough: if Dedicated capacity exhausted we'll route to hosted fallback with tenant isolation. Small detail but they asked.

maria: Good point. I'll add routing/fallback policy to SOW.

jen: I'll also include sample curl commands for POC access and a simple eval prompt set.

maria: Great. Team, please keep replies short — prepping packet now.
